description: A Flutter widget class 'SampleFilesScreen' providing UI to save a sample PDF asset to device storage and display user feedback.

classes.name: SampleFilesScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget that provides a UI screen for saving a sample PDF file to device storage.

methods.name: _saveSamplePdf
methods.description: Loads a PDF asset and saves it to the application documents directory, returning the file path or null on failure.

methods.name: _onSavePressed
methods.description: Handles button press to save the PDF and shows appropriate snackbar notifications.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI layout of the screen with instructions and a button to trigger PDF saving.
